g.text: Without a gene panel, the genome converges on BUB1B
Every gene with a high- or moderate-impact allele competed (6 321 genes). BUB1B leads 14 of 15 rankings and an external tool on the same VCF places it #2 of 398.
It is #4 in the frozen A0 and #1 after repairing missing frequencies: both numbers are always reported. Phase is unresolved, so this is a strong candidate, not a diagnosis.

Sources SHA256-checked: mode_b_results_v4.pkl 3ec48622… (15 frozen rankings) · highmod_ann.tsv 6bb5d139… (universe; A0-FREQFIX recomputed with the notebook-01 formula) · Exomiser BASELINE-PRIMARY genes.tsv 00b8ef31….
Panel C texts: reports/TRACK1_REPORT.md §5, docs/COMPETITOR_AUDIT_LZTR1_IGBP1.md, docs/EXTERNAL_BASELINE.md. Prioritization scores are not test statistics. No coordinates shown.
